input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, User roles. It manages core business objects including user, spring boot with hinernate test2, account. The platform provides capabilities for person, i api, api. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage spring boot with hinernate test2 records, so that I can track and organize spring boot with hinernate test2 data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage account records, so that I can track and organize account data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to interact with test functionality, so that I can accomplish my test-related tasks.
